entry.title: Wade Wilson: The Real Story behind "Handsome Devil"

media:group.media:title: Wade Wilson: The Real Story behind "Handsome Devil"
media:group.media:description:
Check out the full upload here: https://youtu.be/qsiQ17o2fdo
Long before Wade Wilson became known as the "Deadpool Killer," Kelly Matthews lived through a nightmare. After surviving an attack and escaping from the trunk of a car, Kelly went to the police, hoping to put her boyfriend behind bars for good.
But a series of investigative failures allowed Wilson to remain free... a mistake that would have fatal consequences as he escalated his streak of violence across Florida.
Ahead of the Paramount+ docuseries Handsome Devil: Charming Killer, let's look back at the case that should have been stopped before it ever began.
